sample_method: Four seeded random training episodes and four quarterly validation resets; both checkpoints use identical cash-state observations. No environment step after reset.
weight_expectation_definition: Marginal raw target weights before joint normalization and risk limits; not expected executed portfolio weights.
limitations: Eight cash-start states per checkpoint are not exhaustive and do not inspect invested states.
Gate probabilities explain sampled deterministic actions; they do not establish why optimization learned those logits.
A feasible hypothetical Target does not guarantee order fill; no execution was simulated.
No 2025/2026 returns, rewards, or model selection were consulted.
